app.isolation: Only Info.plist language-independent launch environment differed in the QA copy. Synthetic data used a separate Application Support directory.

baseline_nonpass.visual: The real app drew a negative-coordinate mark over the adjacent note controls before pan and again after Return to origin.
baseline_nonpass.keyboard_only: Menu actions could be invoked through accessibility clicks. Keyboard-only traversal did not establish activation.

regression.fixed_renderer: PASS outside pixels unchanged, set-in-view pixels after pan, origin reset, geometry and saved stroke equality

actual_mac_workflow.restore: PASS portable SDK export opened through the native restore picker. One original EPUB and two synthetic notes.
visual: Blank viewport at origin and clean adjacent controls
One Pan left action reveals the original mark inside Scribble
Return to origin hides the mark and leaves the rail clean
actual_mac_workflow.strict_comparison: The EPUB and complete saved desk, revision and observed queues are identical before pan, after pan and after reset.
actual_mac_workflow.text_and_ink: Both original text notes, order, creation context and stroke bytes survive the flip from Scribble back to text and normal process exit/reopen. Only reader positions and revision are permitted to differ on reopen.

limits: Keyboard-only menu traversal, physical input, VoiceOver, endurance and forced termination remain separate
No current iPad candidate install, macOS 14/iPadOS 17 runtime, live service acceptance or archive publication in this check
